name: Queen's Blade 2 ~Ikusa Otome Kankin Rinkan Ryoujoku~
original_name: クイーンズブレード2～戦乙女監禁輪姦陵辱～
source:
Once every four years, the kingdom has a life-or-death tournament to determine the Queen.
Women of all races and nations can participate... but only women!
Every single girl gives her absolutely most to victory...
Because loss equals humiliation beyond fantasy... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE058528.html]DLsite English[/url]]
